description: DeFi yield and lending pools across protocols and chains, updated hourly: supply APY (base + reward), borrow APY for lending pools, TVL and what it counts, 50 per page. Filter by chain, token symbol, stablecoins only and a minimum TVL (use min_tvl_usd of 1000000 or more to skip thin pools, whose APYs swing). Each pool links to its page with the daily history; yield_pool returns that history. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

chain.description: The chain's AlphaGrowth slug (as in /apr/chains/<slug>, e.g. base, ethereum, solana).

min_tvl_usd.description: The smallest TVL in USD a pool needs to be listed.

sort_order.description: desc for the highest first, asc for the lowest.

token.description: A token symbol, matched exactly, case-insensitive (e.g. WETH, WBTC).

name: yield_pools
title: DeFi yield pools
